The beginning

Dedza Dynamos Football Club was founded in Dedza, Central Region of Malawi, establishing football excellence, youth development, and district pride.

Official dates, honours, player statistics, and commercial partnerships are documented from club records and Super League of Malawi (SULOM) archives.

Our home fortress

Dedza Stadium

SULOM designates Dedza Stadium as the club's official home ground with an estimated 10,000 spectator capacity. High in the central highlands, the venue has built a formidable reputation as one of the toughest away fixtures in Malawian football.
